facts_of_case: The parties are the legal representatives of deceased persons. The case is about partition and distribution of ancestral property.

legal_principles.principle: A joint family remains undivided until a partition is actually carried out.
legal_principles.held: The family remained joint and no partition had taken place amongst plaintiffs and defendants.

legal_principles.principle: A person's right to get their share separated is not lost due to a false revenue record.
legal_principles.held: The plaintiffs have not lost their right to get their share separated due to such revenue record.

outcome.final_order: The appeal was allowed, and the court ordered the partition of the ancestral property as per the Hindu Succession Act, 1956.

use_for_drafting: representing clients in intestate succession cases
